services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: We will discuss fishing options with your group prior to departure, and the El Gato Dos crew will work to ensure you a trip of a lifetime. The charter price includes all of your bait, Penn and Phenix fishing tackle, licensing, fillet service, beverages, and snacks. Lunch is provided on Three Quarter and Full Day

services.name: Whale Watching
services.desc: During the winter and spring months, the California Gray Whales make their lengthy migration from the Bering Sea in Alaska to the Baja California Peninsula in Mexico. The close proximity of this migration along the San Diego coastline affords us the excellent opportunity to view these majestic mammals in their natural environment. For the past 35 years, Seaforth Landing has offered daily San Diego whale watching tours from January through mid-March. Depending on the time of year these trips last two to three hours.
